artifact_review: The Router identified text gibberish (severity 2) and texture anomaly on the fork (severity 1). I agree with these findings. The tire text is indeed warped and illegible ('...TYRE...' is barely discernible but lacks crisp embossing). The fork surface does look overly smooth/plastic-like compared to real polished aluminum. I am increasing the artifact severity slightly due to the additional structural ambiguity in the caliper-fork junction which the Router missed.
